title: Retire the soak stage and vocabulary: rewire the system to testing / production / inactive (not just a rules edit)
note: OPERATOR 2026-11-06 ~18:50Z, verbatim: 'I want to make sure that this isn't just like an updated set of rules, but that the system is rewired to reflect that workflow. If it's a big project, then we can push it until the reset ... the soaking pretty much doesn't exist anymore ... anything that's in paper testing is something that's been created but hasn't proven an edge yet, or we haven't decided to put it on live money yet, or it's been demoted after having gone live. But like, it's not for soaking, it's for creating live data ... we need to basically remove that from the vocabulary ... It's testing. If it proves an edge, it goes to live money and paper portfolio. If it doesn't prove a live edge, or if it had a live edge and then lost it, then it goes back to the paper testing ... There's no like soak step in the promotion scale anymore.' Also binding from earlier today: paper is not a gate; the first 1-2 live trades of a new strategy or ML are a verification watch, not a test; mechanics is a separate account path. SIZE (manager, measured 18:52Z, grep -li soak): 449 files (src 107, scripts 148, config 25, .github 181, .claude 13); guards scripts/ci/check_soak_contracts.py and check_soak_registered.py; soak_state/soak_book_grade/soak_alarm scripts; SOAK-stage1-* ids; hourly 'soak(s) changed state' pings; soak_state.mechanics_proven; config/mechanics_paths.yaml. Big, so scheduled AFTER the Wed 11-11 reset per the operator. PLAN: (1) inventory every soak surface as runtime, guard, config, ping, doc or skill, and give each a disposition: rename to testing/production/inactive, keep as a mechanics/first-trade-verification monitor under a new name, or delete; (2) rewire status derivation (scripts/ops/strategy_status.py) and the promotion path so nothing waits on a soak result; (3) per-trade mechanics checks keep running as monitoring (they find real bugs, e.g. reconciler closes), named as such, never as a promotion step; (4) remove soak from OPERATING-PLAN, canonical docs, skills and CLAUDE.md, and retire the soak guards; (5) migrate SOAK-* ids and rows. No new gates. Done = grep -li soak over src/scripts/config/.github/.claude returns only archived history, and the promotion path has no soak state. INVENTORY 2026-11-06 (lane SOAK-BACKLOG-REVIEW, docs/research/soak-backlog-review-2026-11-06.md; population: 56 testing legs from strategy_status.py at 1d52e2294): ZERO pass their Stage-0 bar, so nothing was promoted. 6 stop only at R-HOLDOUT, and in every one the holdout confirmed a different config from the live one: ada_pullback_2h, trend_donchian_eth_4h, trend_donchian_xrp_4h, trend_donchian_sol_prop, slv_trend_1h, trend_donchian_xrp_adx25 (never run). 7 have approximate fidelity, 6 are n<30, 5 have no record, 32 FAIL. FOR THE REWIRE: (1) MD-PROMOTE-S1-S2 bar.soak_passed plus the resolver's _soak_passed / R-NOT-SOAKED / R-EXECUTION-SHADOW clauses still stop every crypto leg without an own soak at R-SOAK-NOT-PASSED (state None), and they read comms/mandate_evidence/soak_state/2026-10-04.json (33 days old). Retire the clause and the snapshot input, and keep mechanics as a path record (config/mechanics_paths.yaml). (2) mechanics_paths.yaml has no Bybit perp path although 6 crypto legs passed own soaks and ml_entry trades on bybit_2. Register bybit_perp_bracket_v1 in the first Bybit promotion PR. (3) ib_live has no ib_portfolio mirror and no IB path, so all 6 ib_paper-only legs need that build before any real-money move. (4) 'Stage 1 soak' wording appears in the resolver's own refusal text (R-NOT-SOAKED 'Stage 2 is reached only through Stage 1'). Filed: PI-20261106-Y7JEXUWW-0001 (live prop legs eth_4h/sol_4h fail the prop superset), -0002 (unhomed 1h legs can't get iteration units), -0003 (iteration_orphans reads ml_entry.json for v2/eq), -0004 (3 holdout-backed Tier-3 config proposals = fastest path to real money). 2026-11-06 lane SOAK-FLIP-FOLLOWUP, soak-surface findings from #23916 (merged 183cd0a73): (a) scripts/ops/soak_state.py STATES gained 'pending' (my addition: clean-reason close with exit price/pnl/fee unwritten, within COST_WRITE_GRACE_HOURS=3) and it is also listed in attention_watch.SOAK_STATES and render_daily_brief quiet_states: rename or fold it when the vocabulary retires. (b) soak_state.grade_trade / evaluate / CLEAN_EXITS (now incl. strategy_close, max_hold) is the per-trade MECHANICS grader and should survive the retirement under a mechanics name; scripts/ops/mechanics_fault_intake.py (hourly step of counterfactual-grade-closed, key mechanics-fault:<trade_id>) already calls it. (c) attention_watch.py section (b2) pings 'soak(s) changed state' on passed/mechanical_fail transitions: the Telegram source of the operator's pings. (d) config/mandates.yaml bar.soak_states [passed, mechanical_fail] and scripts/ops/snapshot_soak_state_for_mandate.py consume the state vocabulary. (e) tests/test_soak_state_pending.py is named for soak_state only because it tests that module; rename with it. Row SOAK-FAULT-INTAKE owns the intake wiring.
